alkylation reagent: reconstituted in lysis buffer containing 8 M urea, 10 mM tris(2-carboxyethyl)phosphine (TCEP) and 40 mM chloroacetamide (CAA) in 50 mM triethylammonium bicarbonate (TEAB).
alkylation concentration: reconstituted in lysis buffer containing 8 M urea, 10 mM tris(2-carboxyethyl)phosphine (TCEP) and 40 mM chloroacetamide (CAA) in 50 mM triethylammonium bicarbonate (TEAB).
cleavage agent: Trypsin (sequencing grade modified trypsin, Promega) was used to digest proteins at 10 ng µl−1 (v/v) at 37°C overnight.
enrichment method: Cells were subjected to subcellular fractionation as described above.
fractionation method: Cells were subjected to subcellular fractionation as described above.
instrument: Orbitrap Fusion Lumos Tribrid mass spectrometer
An Orbitrap Fusion Lumos Tribrid mass spectrometer interfaced with an Ultimate-3000 RS LCnano nanoflow liquid chromatography system (Thermo Scientific) was used to analyse peptides.
labeling: The mass spectrometry proteomics data have been deposited in the ProteomeXchange Consortium via the PRIDE partner repository with the dataset identifier PXD044188.
reduction reagent: reconstituted in lysis buffer containing 8 M urea, 10 mM tris(2-carboxyethyl)phosphine (TCEP) and 40 mM chloroacetamide (CAA) in 50 mM triethylammonium bicarbonate (TEAB).
reduction concentration: reconstituted in lysis buffer containing 8 M urea, 10 mM tris(2-carboxyethyl)phosphine (TCEP) and 40 mM chloroacetamide (CAA) in 50 mM triethylammonium bicarbonate (TEAB).
